title: Study of Pulmonary MRI for the Diagnosis of Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome After Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplantation
brief_summary: Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome (BOS) is a major complication of Hematopoietic Stem cell Transplantation (HSCT) occurring in the context of chronic GVHD and associated with a poor prognosis. The diagnosis of BOS is based on functional (Pulmonary Functional Tests) and morphological criteria (chest CT-scan). Early diagnosis of BOS represents an unmet need and would facilitate early therapeutic interventions. Lung MRI has been recently developed with new sequences facilitating morphological and functional lung analysis in various inflammatory contexts. The goal of this study is to compare the morphological performances of chest CT-scan and MRI
